intentEvidence: HTML image tags offer better compatibility across different platforms compared to Markdown or Obsidian's wikilink format.
motivation: HTML image tags offer better compatibility across different platforms compared to Markdown or Obsidian's wikilink format.
problem: Standard Markdown or Obsidian wikilink formats may not be compatible when sharing notes across different platforms or editors.
summary: Image to HTML converts pasted images into HTML tags instead of standard Markdown or Obsidian wikilinks, offering better cross-platform compatibility.
